body_markdown:
Few vehicles lend themselves to heritage plays the way the Jeep Wrangler does. It’s an inherently antiquated engineering philosophy—two stick axles, body-on-frame, boxy, with a styling throughline that reaches back decades—and that’s why people love it. Jeep’s history is littered with lodestones that make for great throwbacks, and the company’s latest package, the Wrangler JL-2A, nods to a good one.


Jeep


Jeep


Eddy Eckart spotted this CJ-2A recently, fitted with wider wheels in a similar color to the originals.


[Eddy Eckart](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/eeckarthagerty-com/)


[Eddy Eckart](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/eeckarthagerty-com/)


The 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A harkens back to the Willys CJ-2A, the brand’s first civilian-focused model that debuted right after World War II ended. The CJ-2A (CJ stood for “Civilian Jeep”) was heavily based on the wartime Willys MB, but softened a bit at the edges to make it a tad more livable. It was aimed at the agrarian crowd, with practical features such as larger headlights, a tailgate, and a rear power takeoff. It was also the first model to feature the now iconic seven-slat grille (Willys MBs had nine-slat grilles).


Jeep


The 2027 Wrangler JL-2A is a modern adaptation of that rugged and bold early effort. Based on the Rubicon platform and available in either two- or four-door configurations, this special edition package adds some rather fun exterior and interior callbacks.


Jeep


Jeep


The exterior color pictured on the two-door here is called Gobi, and it’s a nod to the Harvest Tan finish that was one of the most popular for the CJ-2A. Meanwhile, the four-door version features an olive green tone called ’41. ([Nodding back to the MB](https://www.hagerty.com/media/car-profiles/happy-veterans-day-to-the-willys-overland-jeep/) , of course.) The wheels wear a color called Joose and are inspired by the Sunset Red wheels on the older Willys. These 17-inchers wear 33-inch BFGoodrich all-terrain tires.


Body-color fender flares, a three-piece hardtop, orange tow hooks front and rear, and a dark metallic gray grille round out the exterior visuals. The package doesn’t veer into too-retro territory, and although the wheels may pop too much for some, the JL-2A is a clean, modern callback to Jeep’s early days.


Jeep


The Wrangler JL-2A’s cabin features tan Nappa leather on the seats and deep brown door panels, creating a markedly different feel in the cabin than most other models. Desert Orange accent stitching is everywhere, tying into the wheel color nicely. Standard equipment includes remote start, an auto-dimming rearview mirror, a universal garage door opener, a front camera, and an integrated washer.


Jeep


Jeep


Jeep


This wouldn’t be a real Jeep without an easter egg or two. On the Wrangler JL-2A, the rear swing gate plaque that would normally have vehicle information such as dimensions, capacities, and off-roading metrics like breakover and approach angles instead has a silhouette of the[Willys CJ-2A](https://www.hagerty.com/media/market-trends/hagerty-insider/the-most-valuable-willys-and-jeep-cjs-from-every-generation/) , a farm scene, and a little half-and-half of the new and old models. Neat stuff.


Jeep


The fourth-generation Wrangler (the JL) debuted in late 2017 as a 2018 model year. Despite getting long in the tooth, the JL continues to sell well—last year’s United States sales fell just shy of 166K, *up* 9.8% from 2024. Special editions like this JL-2A are a savvy way to bolster an aging model’s appeal, and Jeep’s product planners are certainly mining the depths of the Wrangler’s story to create viable options.


Jeep


This is the 11th special edition in a 12-month blitz in which Jeep is unveiling a new special-edition Wrangler to celebrate the nameplate’s 85th anniversary. There have been some real bangers so far, including the[’90s-nodding Laredo](https://www.hagerty.com/media/news/2027-jeep-wrangler-laredo-pairs-retro-looks-with-modern-off-road-capability/) and the[Willys 392](https://www.hagerty.com/media/news/2026-jeep-wrangler-willys-392-pricing-pictures-specs/) , a cheaper way to the Wrangler’s rowdiest powertrain. The JL-2A is a bit more niche, but cool nonetheless.


Order books will open in October for the Wrangler JL-2A, says Jeep. The package carries an MSRP of $4995, which is just $115 more than a similarly equipped Rubicon model. Pricing for 2027 Jeeps is not out yet, but if base prices stay the same as 2026, expect the JL-2A two-door to start around $53,400 ($46,410 MSRP, $1995 destination fee, and $4995 package cost) and the four-door to start around $57,525.
